question:
Choose the correct phrasal verb:
 The topic was sensitive, so he decided to ____ it
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrasal verb **"Back out of"** means to withdraw from something, especially a commitment or agreement. (पीछे हट जाना)
 
 
• **Example:** He backed out of the deal at the last minute, leaving everyone surprised.
 
 
 
• **"Brush through"** is not a correct phrasal verb in this context and doesn't apply to the given statement.
 
• Hence, **"Back out of"** is the correct phrasal verb to use in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Put off** (टालना): To delay or postpone something.
 
 
• **Example:** We had to put off the meeting due to unforeseen circumstances.
 
 
 
• **Go into** (जाना या चर्चा करना): To discuss or examine something in detail.
 
 
• **Example:** We need to go into the details of the project before making a decision.
 
 
 
• **Brush through** (तेजी से गुजरना): To pass over something quickly or without much attention.
 
 
• **Example:** She brushed through the documents without reading them carefully.
